claims.disproof_condition: 條件：聯茂後續法說或年報寫出高速材料營收占比下滑、M9 料號（IT-999GSE2/3）未過客戶認證或停產。核查頻率：每季（聯茂法說簡報）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 降 confidence，重讀高速 CCL 層的供給側。
claims.statement: ITEQ (self, 2Q26 investor presentation): 'Worldwide top supplier in high speed / frequency laminate'; its product line places IT-999GSE2/3 in the M9 Extreme Low Loss class (Df 0.0010~0.0005); hyperscale data center and AI server upgrades drive high speed / frequency material demand and its share there is expected 'to uplift robustly'. Company self-statement that it supplies high-speed CCL (a supply edge, not a bottleneck claim); customers and volumes are not named in these quotes.
